items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: I played back there at Jackson and Durban with Henry Russ.

ctx.x: And Celestan was the last band player? The last band. And then Handy and the WPA were in between. That's right. And Huntley-Guardette? Was with us? No, I mean you played some jobs with him too. Oh, I did play jobs with him. Yeah, but that was after Robert Clark. That's right.
Another place I forgot to tell, I played there a long time ago, the Rhythm Club. I played back there at Jackson and Durban with Henry Russ.
